007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.DatabaseAdmin;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import org.slf4j.Logger;
013import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
014
015import java.util.Arrays;
016import java.util.List;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for revoking network access from Select AI users.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link DatabaseAdmin} client and call
022 * {@link DatabaseAdmin#revokeNetworkAccess(List, String, List, Integer, Integer)}.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>This sample changes database state by removing network ACL entries for
025 * the supplied users, host, privileges, and optional port range. It does not
026 * revoke package privileges; use {@code RevokePrivilegesSample} when package
027 * privileges should be revoked. Use {@code RevokeHttpAccessSample} to exercise
028 * the separate {@link DatabaseAdmin#revokeHttpAccess(List, String)} public API.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>This sample requires a database user authorized to perform administrative
031 * setup operations such as package privilege changes, data-access
032 * configuration, or network ACL updates. Do not run administrative samples with
033 * normal application runtime credentials.</p>
034 *
035 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
036 * <ul>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_NETWORK_USERS - comma-separated database users</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_NETWORK_HOST</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_NETWORK_PRIVILEGES - comma-separated ACL privileges, for example {@code http,connect}</li>
043 * </ul>
044 *
045 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
046 * <ul>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_NETWORK_LOWER_PORT</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_NETWORK_UPPER_PORT</li>
049 * </ul>
050 *
051 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
052 * <pre>{@code
053 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
054 * }</pre>
055 *
056 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
057 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
058 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * mvn clean install
061 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
062 * }</pre>
063 *
064 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
065 * <pre>{@code
066 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/databaseadmin/RevokeNetworkAccessSample.java
067 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin.RevokeNetworkAccessSample
068 * }</pre>
069 *
070 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
071 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
072 * and diagnostics.</p>
073 */
074public final class RevokeNetworkAccessSample {
075    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RevokeNetworkAccessSample.class);
076
077    private RevokeNetworkAccessSample() {
078    }
079
080    public static void main(String[] args) {
081        List<String> users = parseList(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_NETWORK_USERS"), "SELECTAI_NETWORK_USERS");
082        String host = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_NETWORK_HOST");
083        List<String> privileges = parseList(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_NETWORK_PRIVILEGES"),
084                "SELECTAI_NETWORK_PRIVILEGES");
085        Integer lowerPort = optionalIntegerEnv("SELECTAI_NETWORK_LOWER_PORT");
086        Integer upperPort = optionalIntegerEnv("SELECTAI_NETWORK_UPPER_PORT");
087
088        try (DatabaseAdmin databaseAdmin = createDatabaseAdmin()) {
089            boolean disabled = databaseAdmin.revokeNetworkAccess(users, host, privileges, lowerPort, upperPort);
090
091            System.out.printf("Revoke network access completed: %s%n", disabled);
092            System.out.printf("Users: %s%n", users);
093            System.out.printf("Host: %s%n", host);
094            System.out.printf("Privileges: %s%n", privileges);
095            System.out.printf("Lower port: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(lowerPort));
096            System.out.printf("Upper port: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(upperPort));
097        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
098            LOGGER.error("Failed to revoke Select AI network access for users {}.", users, e);
099        }
100    }
101
102    private static DatabaseAdmin createDatabaseAdmin() throws SelectAIException {
103        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
104                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
105                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
106                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
107                .build();
108
109        return DatabaseAdmin.create(dbConnectionConfig);
110    }
111
112    private static List<String> parseList(String value, String envName) {
113        List<String> values = Arrays.stream(value.split(","))
114                .map(String::trim)
115                .filter(item -> !item.isEmpty())
116                .toList();
117        if (values.isEmpty()) {
118            throw new IllegalStateException(envName + " must contain at least one value");
119        }
120        return values;
121    }
122
123    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
124        String value = System.getenv(name);
125        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
126            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
127        }
128        return value;
129    }
130
131    private static Integer optionalIntegerEnv(String name) {
132        String value = System.getenv(name);
133        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
134            return null;
135        }
136        return Integer.valueOf(value.trim());
137    }
138
139    private static String valueOrEmpty(Integer value) {
140        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
141    }
142}
